//: DRY-RUN ONLY. This file must never contain credentials and must never set dry_run to false. scripts/safe-run.py refuses to start otherwise.
//minimal_roi: Effectively disabled: a reachable ROI table would silently pre-empt the exit signal and the stop, which section 6 of the master instruction forbids.
//stoploss: Hard backstop only. The real stop is the per-trade ATR stop supplied by custom_stoploss. -0.15 can only ever cut EARLIER than a wider ATR stop, never later, so it cannot enlarge the modelled loss.
//use_custom_stoploss: Set on the strategy class, not here.

order_types.//stoploss_on_exchange: VERIFIED FALSE for Hyperliquid spot in freqtrade 2026.8 (Hyperliquid._ft_has). Setting it true would be silently ignored or rejected; the bot-internal stop is all we have. This is recorded as a LIVE_BLOCKER.

exchange.name: hyperliquid
exchange.//credentials: Intentionally absent. A keyless dry run needs no wallet address and no private key. scripts/safe-run.py rejects startup if any credential field is populated.
exchange.//pair_whitelist_warning: ccxt labels these BTC/ETH/SOL, but the exchange market ids are @142/@151/@156, whose real base tokens are UBTC/UETH/USOL - Unit-bridge issued wrappers, NOT native BTC/ETH/SOL. See docs/CAPABILITIES.md. Do not read these names as native assets.

telegram.//: Optional by design. The bot must run without a token or chat id.
